correctness.rationale: The Rota–Baxter identity is reduced on basis pairs to P(1)=u in the square-zero radical and T=P|V with T squared zero. The characteristic-two converse cancels 2abTu. Thus P cubed is zero and P squared(1)=Tu; an explicit rank-one T realizes index three for radical dimension at least two. Canonical Jordan splitting and transitive centralizer actions prove the orbit strata. Image/ker flags count each rank. The exact Gaussian product form and dominated convergence prove the sharp fixed-field probability, and direct enumeration verifies small instances.

value.rationale: This identifies a sharp modular discontinuity in an intrinsic RB nilpotency-index invariant of first-order local algebras and fully classifies operators up to algebra automorphisms. The count and sharp fixed-field asymptotic prove index-three behavior is typical, making the phenomenon structural rather than a small-characteristic example. These invariants naturally inform classification, moduli and finite-field statistics of RB structures.
